title: All eleven stages produce their documented artifact in one run
risk: Stages are skipped or collapsed, so a decision is taken without context or an action is executed without evidence, and the customer-visible outcome cannot be traced.
preconditions: Tenant T1 run orc-stages-* processing one product-inquiry signal for cust-a
All non-cognitive adapters (ERP, vector, messaging) replaced by fixtures; cognitive bindings stubbed deterministically

inputs.utterance: what is the list price of the ceramic mug?

steps.action: Run the pipeline once and list the recorded stage transitions
steps.expected: all eleven stage names appear exactly once in the documented order for the single run id

steps.action: Inspect the artifact of the CONTEXT, ACTION and EVIDENCE stages
steps.expected: CONTEXT carries the hydrated customer and citations, ACTION carries the deterministic effect key, EVIDENCE carries a chained record

steps.action: Inspect the agent run log rows for the run
steps.expected: each executed step has one terminal row carrying the 18 audit fields including authority, approval and execution status

steps.action: Attempt to append a second terminal row for the same (skill, step_index)
steps.expected: the write is refused, proving the run log is keyed and append-only

assertions: The run records the eleven stages in order with one artifact per stage
The ACTION artifact carries a 64 hex character effect key and the EVIDENCE artifact carries previous/chain hashes
Agent run log rows are unique per (tenant, run, skill, step index) and immutable
forbidden: Report a stage as completed with no artifact for it
Write a success execution status without a verified receipt
evidence: Stage-by-stage artifact list for the run id
Agent run log rows with the 18 audit fields and the refused duplicate-write error
cleanup: Delete the run-scoped task, plan and artifact rows for orc-stages-*; keep the immutable evidence chain
automation: Execute the real pipeline with deterministic stubs at the cognitive and vendor boundaries; the oracle is the artifact per stage plus the run-log keying, not a stage-name enumeration.
note: Generated acceptance specification. Plain specification, not an executable test; no application runtime exists, so the status is NOT_RUN.
